initial_application: Jira records the issue as added to the build in HL7/fhir#1915 at merge commit ac2fc544a89b776e38de985c552dea367e7bcc6c. Git history shows cc606229a62979b19f2a5523922023ccabf235d7 updated source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml with the new short text and ImagingSelection targetProfile.
additional_context: Observation and ImagingSelection are active resources in source/fhir.ini. The current Observation StructureDefinition still has the requested text and targetProfile. OO Confluence minutes show FHIR-36490 was added to the April 2022 block and accepted in the 2022-04-28 block vote. Quoted Zulip search found no directly relevant discussion, and Jira neighborhood searches found no later reversal for this core Observation.derivedFrom decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the active current source already satisfies FHIR-36490.
